scope: Only checkpoint-3 synthetic reply evidence, approved fixture and keyless raw transport captures, related Unicode tests and explicitly requested uncertainty-control source concern. No builds, devices, private user data, ciphertext disclosure or fixture-key access.

rawInspection.format: Two binary streams containing four-byte big-endian length-prefixed UTF-8 JSON encrypted frames. No JSONL file was present.
rawInspection.publicMetadataBoundary: Version, source/target device IDs, sequence, issuedAt and replay nonce are visible by protocol design; route fields, message content and inner event identity are not exposed as outer JSON fields. This is not metadata-hiding transport.
limits: No key was read and no frame was decrypted. Authentication/decryption success comes from the endpoint logs and production-used test paths, not this keyless scan.
Absence of the 21 selected known markers is not proof that all possible plaintext can never leak.
Increasing sequences and distinct nonces in three frames do not independently prove every replay rejection path.
Capture is a local TCP relay, not a radio/network-wide packet capture.

observedScope: Real synthetic PendingIntent/RemoteInput delivery once; replacement/removal revoke and protected/data-only actions reject.
Eight synthetic preflight-then-revocation cases reject with no receiver send or executed Ack.
Reconnect yields a fresh one-use route; canceled PendingIntent and outcome-send failure do not restore or automatically resend tokens.
Exact Unicode/whitespace bytes survive Swift reply, encrypted transport, Kotlin decode and RemoteInput result.

mac.result: Authenticated Android message, Swift reply sent, Android execution acknowledgement accepted.

endpointEvidence.countInterpretation: Two Android-to-Mac frames and one reverse frame agree with the source/log message, reply and execution-ack exchange. Their inner types are not claimed decoded by the keyless scan.

runtimeCoverageLimits: The harness uses real production RemoteInputReplyExecutor, route/action registries, SharedReplyDispatchAuthority and InboundCommandHandler with synthetic PendingIntents.

OS-access, feature and peer state are injected in the revocation tests. Actual NotificationListenerService binding/destruction, OS permission revocation UI and the complete PlinkSessionController authorization closure are not executed by those scenarios.
The encrypted roundtrip invokes a synthetic-authority executor; it is not native Mac Notification Center text entry or real-recipient delivery.
The eight local revocation cases run before the network roundtrip. Three captured network frames do not represent all local negative scenarios.
No physical Pixel, carrier call, laptop speech or real-recipient message was exercised.

buildBinding.limit: Manifest explicitly awaits installed-APK hash from matching UI capture. Local source/binary equality and successful install log do not independently prove the installed package hash. This evidence must not be rebound to a later source/build that fixes I3-L2-03.

unicodeTests.assessment: 2,000 emoji or decomposed e+acute repetitions reach 4,000 UTF-16 units and pass with exact UTF-8 bytes; 2,001 reject through both preflight and generic policy; rejected local input retains the context. No new test defect found.

sourceFollowup.scenario: A recoverable computerAudio timeout publishes the same active context with stateIsCertain=false. updateCall accepts context/phase/waiting and then returns for identical ID+number, leaving the End Call control even though the controller rejects actions pending reconnect.
sourceFollowup.minimalFix: Require stateIsCertain in the existing eligibility guard before deduplication; use the existing removal/reset branch when uncertain.

retain: Exact historical manifest and build log binding this run
cleanup.note: The two listed raw streams have been independently scanned in full and their hashes/counts are retained here. Parent may delete those raw files; no future review work is waiting on them.

acceptance.nativeUIEvidence: Rawls matching capture pending; not inspected in this report.
